integrity: The exact standalone Python verifier recomputes determinant norms, reduced line structures, and finite-field incidences from the printed coefficient table. Its success does not constitute independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the fixed integral plane arrangement defined by 28 published quadratic-integer line forms; exceptional fibers do not generally remain bitangents of smooth quartics. It does not determine embedded singular-scheme lengths, complete moduli classifications, or historical priority against unindexed research. Characteristic-three Hermitian incidence and generic counts are known inputs.
title: Exceptional-prime reductions of Klein's 28-bitangent line arrangement
